activity_summary: You came home with the bells still going at four. Field had looked up and had not asked. The letter stayed sealed for the eleventh. Phillips was still not told.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came in at four and left both things where they were.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Remembered as the man who looked up and did not ask.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Still unwarned. Not in the house.

entities.name: the eleventh
entities.context: Mentioned in Still going at four

facets.activity: Named the bells, the look, and the seal

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: He looked up, and he did not ask.
